title: Bipartite Matching
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Line 1: L R m; then m lines u v — left node u
compatible with right node v. Print the MAXIMUM MATCHING size.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ L, R, m ≤ 2000.

Model as flow: source→left→right→sink, all caps 1. Greedy without
augmenting paths undercounts on the right graph.

tests.name: perfect matching
greedy undercounts: shared neighbor taken first
tests.hint: Greedy: left1 takes right1, left2's only neighbor right1 is used → 1. Augmenting path rematches left1→right2: max 2.

tests.name: greedy undercounts: chain of steals
imperfect ceiling
tests.hint: All three left nodes only reach right1: matching ceiling 1 — flow and greedy agree here.
